# Steinberg ASIO SDK headers

These are the three upstream interface headers needed by the Windows ASIO host:
`asiosys.h`, `asio.h`, and `iasiodrv.h`.

- Source: Steinberg ASIO SDK 2.3.4, distributed in the `audiosdk/asio` SDK mirror.
- Retrieved from commit `496a0765b8bb9c26f764f22f9a9712a937177db2`.
- Upstream: <https://github.com/audiosdk/asio>
- Steinberg developer SDK page: <https://www.steinberg.net/developers/asiosdk-open/>
- License terms: see [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt). The included headers identify themselves as Steinberg SDK files governed by those terms. This project uses the GPL Version 3 grant for these files.

The SDK files remain unmodified. Keep their notices and license with any redistribution.
